## Scope

Recover the repository from accumulated dependency and automation drift while preserving CLI behavior and release quality. The goal covers GitHub advisory triage, runtime and development dependency upgrades, Actions modernization, source/security review, package verification, and durable pm governance.

## Success measures

- Zero known dependency vulnerabilities in the resolved lockfile.
- All required local and GitHub checks pass on one coherent upgrade head.
- Existing Dependabot backlog is superseded without losing issue lineage.
- Repository-local pm state captures goals, plans, findings, evidence, and future improvements.
Make searxng-cli secure, current, and sustainably maintainable
Eliminate known vulnerabilities and dependency drift, restore dependable CI, establish comprehensive project tracking, and leave a documented modernization roadmap.

bun audit reports zero vulnerabilities; unit, e2e, coverage, build, formatting, typecheck, and package smoke checks pass; GitHub required checks pass on the consolidated pull request; pm health and validation pass with both .toon items and .jsonl histories committed
Canonical repository cloned; authenticated gh and pm 2026.7.16 available; GitHub and baseline inventories collected.
Protect users and contributors while reducing maintenance overhead.
Removes exploitable development/runtime dependency paths and makes updates reliably shippable.
A green, vulnerability-free, documented repository with governed project context.
Two GitHub alerts and 11 stale dependency PRs have accumulated, while local audit finds 41 advisories and runner deprecation warnings.
